remarks: Shippan Point home has sparkling water views over Long Island Sound! Welcome to your seaside escape located in coveted Marina Bay. This bright and spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath duplex condominium is perfectly sited just steps to the beach and minutes to Metro North train, and downtown shopping. Designed with an open-floor plan and flooded with natural light, the main level features an updated galley kitchen with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, and custom cabinets. The kitchen flows seamlessly into the dining area, where sliders open onto a private balcony-your perfect venue for relaxing or entertaining with spectacular water views. The adjoining oversized living room has a warming wood fireplace. A tastefully updated powder room and plenty of storage complete the main floor. Upstairs, the serene primary suite offers a luxurious private balcony overlooking Long Island Sound, a spacious layout with a walk-in closet, and a full en-suite bath. The second bedroom is filled with natural light and features custom closets, making it perfect as a guest room, home office, or both. A second full bath, laundry, and central vacuum are conveniently located on this level as well. Enjoy resort-style living with access to beautifully landscaped grounds, a waterfront in-ground pool, kayak racks, bike room, grills and a recently renovated clubhouse.
